notes: *which* is added under rule 55: קְטַנֵּי־אָרֶץ is the predicate of the tripartite clause אַרְבָּעָה הֵם, not an articleless attributive standing on an explicit noun, so rule 41's relative case does not reach it. Reading it as rule 41's attributive was the competing analysis.
הֵם is the unrendered occurrence in the first line while the explicit הֵמָּה takes the written *they* in the second: the ASV realizes the subject once per line.
The construct relation of קְטַנֵּי־אָרֶץ is recast with *upon*, which belongs to the rectum under rule 19, with the supplied *the* standing before its own word.
